notes: New. Low-GWP refrigerants (MAC, chillers, HPs); some foam/propellant use. HS2022-only split.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); other mixtures, not included in the subheadings above,
notes: New. Catch-all HFC blends incl. HFO/HFC low-GWP refrigerants; also non-refrigerant blends.

hs6_desc: Air conditioning machines; containing a motor driven fan, other than window or wall types, incorporating a refrigerating unit
notes: Rooftop/packaged ACs with refrigerating unit; GD labels it 'condenser coil'. ~$11.5bn (HS92 parent).

hs6_desc: Saturated fluorinated derivatives of acyclic hydrocarbons; 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane (HFC-134a) and 1,1,2,2-tetrafluoroethane (HFC-134)
notes: New. Chillers, MAC, fridges; some MDI/foam use. HS2022-only split.

hs6_desc: Saturated fluorinated derivatives of acyclic hydrocarbons; difluoromethane (HFC-32)
notes: New. Main refrigerant for new split ACs/heat pumps. HS2022-only split (HS92 290330); value from Comtrade H6.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); containing 15% or more by mass of 1,1,1-trifluoroethan
notes: New. HFC blends with >=15% HFC-143a; commercial refrigeration. HS2022 heading 3827; no HS92 value.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); other mixtures, not included in the subheadings above,
notes: New. HFC blends >=30% HFC-134a without HFOs. Tree desc truncated.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); other mixtures not included in the subheadings above,
notes: New. HFC blends >=40% HFC-125 (R-410A, R-407A); legacy AC/HP refrigerant. Tree desc truncated.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); other mixtures, not included in the subheading above,
notes: New. HFC blends >=55% HFC-125 without HFOs (R-422A/D, R-434A R-22 drop-ins). Completes 3827.6x refrigerant set. Tree desc truncated; no HS92 value.

hs6_desc: Mixtures containing halogenated derivatives of methane, ethane or propane; containing other hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) but not containing chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs); other mixtures, not included in the subheadings above,
notes: New. HFC/HFO blends >=20% HFC-32 and >=20% HFC-125 (R-448A/R-449A, low-GWP R-404A replacements). Tree desc truncated; no HS92 value.

hs6_desc: Saturated fluorinated derivatives of acyclic hydrocarbons; pentafluoroethane (HFC-125), 1,1,1-trifluoroethane (HFC-143a) and 1,1,2-trifluoroethane (HFC-143)
notes: New. Blend components of R-410A/R-404A/R-407C; minor fire-suppression use. HS2022-only split.

hs6_desc: Refrigerating or freezing equipment; parts thereof, other than furniture
notes: Parts of 8418 equipment incl. household fridges; mixed ($7.7bn).

hs6_desc: Compressors; of a kind used in refrigerating equipment
notes: Rotary/scroll/reciprocating compressors for refrigerating and HP equipment; domestic fridges a minority. ~$16.0bn.

hs6_desc: Air conditioning machines; containing a motor driven fan, other than window or wall types, incorporating a refrigerating unit and a valve for reversal of the cooling/heat cycle (reversible heat pumps)
notes: Reversible AC/heat pumps other than window/wall/split types. ~$3.2bn.

hs6_desc: Air conditioning machines; comprising a motor-driven fan and elements for changing the temperature and humidity, of a kind designed to be fixed to a window, wall, ceiling or floor, self-contained or 'split-system'
notes: New. Most air-to-air heat pumps (reversible splits) classify here, not 841581; GD misses it. ~$18.9bn.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, electron beam furnaces
notes: New; replaces GD 851430 (HS2017) with 851432/851439. Very small.

hs6_desc: Carbon electrodes; with or without metal, of a kind used for furnaces
notes: New. EAF/submerged-arc electrodes and smelter anodes: electrometallurgy consumables. A Graphite may want secondary. ~$2.1bn.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, resistance heated; hot isostatic presses
notes: New HS2022 line (from 851410). Electric HIP for powder metallurgy/AM; niche.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, functioning by induction or dielectric loss
notes: New. Induction melting/microwave furnaces; core electrified process heat. ~$0.6bn.

hs6_desc: Heating equipment; for the heat treatment of materials by induction or dielectric loss, industrial or laboratory, other than furnaces and ovens
notes: Induction hardening, RF/microwave heating (non-furnace). GD lists under Magnets/Solar. ~$0.8bn.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, other than electron beam, plasma or vacuum arc furnaces
notes: New; replaces GD 851430. Residual electric furnaces incl. direct-arc furnaces.

hs6_desc: Furnaces, ovens and heating equipment; parts of the industrial or laboratory equipment of heading no. 8514
notes: Parts of 8514 equipment; GD lists under Geothermal. ~$3.4bn.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, plasma and vacuum arc furnaces
notes: Replaces GD 851430; GD lists it under Solar (silicon furnaces). ~$0.9bn for 851431-39 combined.

hs6_desc: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, resistance heated; other than hot isostatic presses, for the manufacture of semiconductor devices on semiconductor wafers
notes: New (replaces part of HS2017 851410). Electric resistance kilns/ovens. Tree desc garbled; legal text 'other'.

hs6_desc: Refrigerating or freezing equipment; n.e.c. in heading no. 8418
notes: Secondary; primary Heat pumps/cooling. Water chillers are the main DC cooling plant; DC share not identifiable.

hs6_desc: Electrical static converters
notes: Secondary; primary B Power electronics. HS limitation: UPS have no own line; data-centre share small.

hs6_desc: Electrical machines and apparatus; for electroplating, electrolysis or electrophoresis
notes: Only HS line for electrolyser stacks/systems; shared with electroplating lines. Core despite spec 3. ~$1.6bn.

hs6_desc: Metals; iridium, osmium, ruthenium, unwrought or in powder form
notes: Secondary; primary A Critical minerals. Electrochemical uses are a large share of Ir/Ru demand; electronics also.

hs6_desc: Ammonia; anhydrous
notes: Spec 3 kept core: only HS line for ammonia. Trade is fossil fertiliser ammonia; incumbent-trade proxy, not low-emission output. GD lists only under Solar. ~$6.1bn.

hs6_desc: Biodiesel and mixtures thereof; not containing or containing less than 70% by weight of petroleum oils or oils obtained from bituminous minerals
notes: New. Dedicated biodiesel line. HVO/SAF have no own line. HS92 parent 382390 overstates value.

hs6_desc: Ethyl alcohol and other spirits; denatured, of any strength
notes: Denatured ethanol is mostly fuel grade; some industrial/solvent use. ~$3.4bn.

hs6_desc: Hydrogen
notes: New. The molecule itself; HS cannot separate electrolytic from fossil H2; trade tiny (~$0.2bn).

hs6_desc: Alcohols; saturated monohydric, methanol (methyl alcohol)
notes: New. Spec 3 kept core: only HS line for methanol. Fossil chemical feedstock dominates; e-/bio-methanol not separable. Incumbent-trade proxy. ~$10.1bn.

hs6_desc: Undenatured ethyl alcohol; of an alcoholic strength by volume of 80% vol. or higher
notes: New. Brazil ships fuel ethanol here, but beverage/industrial alcohol also. ~$8.2bn.

hs6_desc: Animal, vegetable or microbial fats, oils and their fractions; boiled, oxidised, dehydrated or otherwise chemically modified, excluding those of heading no. 1516, inedible mixtures or preparations of fats, oils or their fractions, n.e.c. in chapter 15
segment: Used cooking oil & inedible fat blends
notes: New. Main waste feedstock for HVO/SAF (China UCO exports); also chemically modified oils. ~$8.4bn.

hs6_desc: Wood; for fuel, sawdust and wood waste and scrap, agglomerated in wood pellets
notes: New; replaces GD 440130 (obsolete). Bioenergy fuel for power and heat; sustainability contested.

hs6_desc: Ferrous products; obtained by direct reduction of iron ore, in lumps, pellets or similar forms
notes: New. H2-DRI is the near-zero steel route; today mostly gas-based DRI. ~$4.2bn.
